mentions.name: Keepy-uppy ping pong paddle game
mentions.description: A physical game built around a sensor-equipped ping pong paddle that tracks how often you hit the ball, functioning like a "keepy uppy" game with scorekeeping. The build combines Arduino development and circuitry, 3D printing, PCB design, and woodworking, with LLM assistance making the skills more approachable.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m speed-running a bunch of new hobbies to teach myself how to make a physical game (basically its a ping pong paddle that tracks how often you hit a ball — like a “keepy uppy” game with scorekeeping)
